description: Hand-authored :8893 field and state closure cases. Model outputs are scripted, not evaluated. No provider calls.

scenarios.name: Permanent home and optional priorities
scenarios.purpose: Close rarely volunteered residence fields and optional goal/priority detail without inventing a move date.

action.message: My permanent home is ZIP 34102, Collier, FL. This is my permanent home, not a seasonal address.

fields.homeStatus: my permanent home, not a seasonal address

fields.text: Help at home matters to me

guide.needs.priorityOther: Help at home matters to me

RC02.homeStatus: my permanent home, not a seasonal address

scenarios.name: Eligibility age range and reported drug gap
scenarios.purpose: A broad age range and a drug-gap report remain distinct from an exact birthday or verified penalty.

action.message: I first qualified through disability before 65. My current age range is under 65.
My notice says the drug coverage is creditable. I had no drug coverage from June 2026 through July 2026.

fields.gap: no drug coverage from June 2026 through July 2026

RC12.gap: no drug coverage from June 2026 through July 2026

scenarios.name: Brand preference and fill supply
scenarios.purpose: Capture volunteered brand and supply labels only for the named unverified medicine; do not synthesize legacy guide medicine/pharmacy structures.

action.message: For my first medicine, Example Alpha 5 mg tablet, I prefer brand only.
I fill Example Alpha as 30 tablets for 30 days, a 30-day supply, from Example Pharmacy, 1 Test Street, Naples, by retail.

scenarios.name: Field-specific unknown and deferred
scenarios.purpose: Explicit missing medicine label and fill fields do not erase known sibling values or become No.

action.message: My medicine is Example Beta tablet. I do not know its strength; check later for the brand.
I use Example Beta as 30 tablets. I do not know the days supply. Check later for the pharmacy and channel.

scenarios.name: Conflicting start and explicit correction
scenarios.purpose: An exact desired month conflict needs clarification; a clear correction replaces the stale month, never birthday or actual Part B.

action.message: I want my Medicare coverage to start in December 2026.
Actually, I want my Medicare coverage to start in January 2027.

scenarios.name: Qualification correction invalidates payer threshold
scenarios.purpose: A reported response to an age-65 payer threshold is not reused for a disability threshold.

action.message: Correction: I first qualified through disability before 65.

scenarios.name: Helper familiarity and wrong-person insurance
scenarios.purpose: The learner can report needing explanation; their own insurance must not become the beneficiary's.

action.message: I am new to Medicare. My mother is the person we are helping; I have insurance through my own job.

scenarios.name: Same-name medicines and one-item correction
scenarios.purpose: Distinct reported strengths remain distinct entities; correcting one item invalidates only its fill scenario.

action.message: Correction: the first Example Gamma, medicine-1, is a 20 mg tablet.

scenarios.name: Explicit None retires provider reports
scenarios.purpose: A direct No is not an unknown; retired doctor details must not return as current reports.

scenarios.name: Military report and legacy optional detail boundary
scenarios.purpose: The supported military report mirrors G13. Unsupported direct choice IDs G01-G12/G14 are each rejected and their held optional report paths remain absent.

scenarios.name: Unrecognized legacy medicine payloads rejected
scenarios.purpose: Current T07 accepts medicine names, not hidden medicationDetails/pharmacies payloads. No fake field coverage is created.

scenarios.name: Original versus Advantage clarification
scenarios.purpose: The dedicated current-versus-different-period clarification field remains its own report, never a new verified coverage conclusion.

scenarios.name: Unknown baseline versus explicit no coverage
scenarios.purpose: Unknown and deferred baseline dispositions remain different from none, while other independent preferences remain usable.

scenarios.name: Explicit residence unknowns preserve independent known home
scenarios.purpose: A deferred home clarification does not manufacture a moving/seasonal status or erase a known home ZIP.

action.message: My permanent-home ZIP is 34102. I do not know my home county; check the seasonal-home status later.

scenarios.name: Reported retirement and birthday without an inferred year
scenarios.purpose: Capture current explicit life circumstances through v3 semantic proposals, separately from retirement insurance, desired start, actual enrollment and an unstated birthday year.

action.message: I've been retired for a few years, and am turning 65 in November.

updates.quote: I've been retired for a few years, and am turning 65 in November.

scenarios.name: Administrator-reported family effect and current provider item
scenarios.purpose: Exercise a positive administrator-reported family impact plus the supported current doctor aggregate bookkeeping, without declaring verified effects or network participation.
